input_file.description: Path to the input pcap or Bro connection log file. Empty string means stdin.

top_n.description: Number of top items to display for hosts, protocols, ports, etc.

count_bytes.description: Count fractions in terms of bytes (1) rather than packets/connections (0).

tcp_only.description: Include only TCP traffic (1) or all protocols (0).

udp_only.description: Include only UDP traffic (1) or all protocols (0).

external_only.description: Ignore strictly internal traffic (1) or include it (0).

resolve_names.description: Resolve host names (1) or display IP addresses (0).

sample_factor.description: Sample factor of input (integer > 1). 0 means no sampling.

do_sample.description: Sample input with probability (0.0 < prob < 1.0). 0.0 means no sampling.

save_mem.description: Do not make memory-expensive statistics (1) or enable full statistics (0).

local_nets_file.description: Path to a file containing CIDRs for local networks to differentiate in/out traffic. Empty if not used.

exclude_nets_file.description: Path to a file containing CIDRs to exclude from analysis. Empty if not used.

ports_file.description: Path to a file containing ports to include in analysis. Empty if not used.

write_ports_file.description: Prefix for writing top total/incoming/outgoing ports into files. Empty if not used.

min_time.description: Minimum time in ISO format (e.g. 2005-12-31-23-59-00) to filter input. Empty if not used.

max_time.description: Maximum time in ISO format (e.g. 2005-12-31-23-59-00) to filter input. Empty if not used.

interval_length.description: Create summaries for time intervals of given length in seconds. 0 for no intervals.
